# Shader Tiler attribution

Source: https://github.com/profesorshader/shader-tiler

Copyright (c) 2026 Profesor Shader. Distributed under the MIT license in LICENSE.

The tutorial sky uses the repository's `textures/background-space.png` and
`textures/star.png`, copied into `img/sky/tutorial/`. Its three-layer star tiling,
random size and placement, and rotation adapt `shaders/tiler.gdshader` and
`materials/stars1.tres`, `stars2.tres`, and `stars3.tres` to a Godot 3D sky shader.
